description: This Java class 'Utils' provides utility methods for resource management, specifically for closing streams safely, and for reading and writing binary data from files.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for safely closing resources, and for reading from and writing to files.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Closes a Closeable resource quietly, ignoring any IOExceptions.

methods.name: closeWithErrorQuietly
methods.description: Closes a ParcelFileDescriptor quietly with an optional error message.

methods.name: writeFully
methods.description: Writes the given byte array fully to a specified file.

methods.name: readFully
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a byte array.
